assets.prompt: The Splinter, a stray: the broken-off lower end of a Wood staff with a jagged top and two snapped-off twigs, and a Wood ferrule; its one eye floats where the rest used to be. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eyes and brows) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
